title: Cambridge IELTS 10 – Test 4 (Writing)
description: Writing Test 4: Task 1 (sơ đồ vòng đời cá hồi – 150 từ, 20 phút) và Task 2 (bảo tàng thu phí vào cửa: lợi nhiều hơn hại? – 250 từ, 40 phút). Ảnh sơ đồ đã nhúng sẵn. Bài làm giáo viên chấm tay.

units.title: Writing Task 1 – The life cycle of the salmon
units.content:
The diagrams below show the life cycle of a species of large fish called the salmon.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

units.title: Writing Task 2 – Charging for admission to museums
units.content:
Write about the following topic:

Many museums charge for admission while others are free.

Do you think the advantages of charging people for admission to museums outweigh the disadvantages?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
